M3.02 independent review — verdict REQUEST-CHANGES (small, bounded). Read-only; no sbt.
Candidate 8becf752949a3b7c7fadc222efe8f6fa7f21eba5, base 22eafac8. Blobs: PatternArtifact.scala 6e896da5, PatternArtifactSuite.scala 15771e5f, AlderPatternArtifact.scala 6eddb16c, AlderPatternArtifactSuite.scala 1f128589. Line refs = PatternArtifact.scala unless noted. Reviewer: fresh-context subagent; majors 1,2,4 re-verified by me against source; 3 reasoned, not compiled.

MAJOR
1 Intercept declared but valueless (:25, :75-81, :132). ExplicitIntercept(neuralAxis) names an axis but stores no mu; forwardMean always returns A C^T y regardless of centering. An ExplicitIntercept artifact (suite :46) silently yields a forward mean without mu. No target mean/centering receipt for continuous y either. Fix: carry AxisValues[P] intercept (+ target-centering receipt) and apply or refuse in forwardMean.
2 "Verified" full rank has no tolerance (:63, :91). fullColumnRank = (M^T M).cholesky.isRight; Gale CholeskyOptions default pivotTolerance=0.0 (Factorizations.scala:63), so near-collinear/rounded-collinear columns pass and get labelled VerifiedByGaleGramCholesky; Gram also squares the condition number. Fix: scale-relative tolerance or condition bound (pivoted QR/SVD via Gale) and record the tolerance in the evidence.
3 (plausible, not compiled) forwardMean likely uncallable via the artifact (:69, :75, :116). PatternArtifact.factors: PatternFactors[?,?,?] with invariant AxisValues[Q] param, so artifact.factors.forwardMean(v) should fail to typecheck for any concrete v; no test calls it through the artifact. Descriptor check at :76 already guards at runtime. Fix: accept AxisValues[?] or keep type params on PatternArtifact; add a test calling through artifact.factors. Your compile gate can settle this.
4 Negative tests weak (PatternArtifactSuite). All negatives assert only isLeft; several fail for >1 reason (:40 2x2 contrast is both rank-1 and >K-1; :48 wrong axis + blank name). :29-30 check fixture constants. Untested: PatternFactors InvalidRank (r>min(p,q), r<=0); Verified rejection of rank-deficient A/C; non-centered contrast; priors not summing to 1; artifact-level K-1 (:129); intercept axis mismatch; invalid DiagonalPlusLowRank; empty lineage; each continuous rejection; a near-singular fixture for (2). Fix: assert specific error variants, single-cause cases.

MINOR (fix or declare as caveats)
5 Contrast centering unweighted (:66-67) while priors may be non-uniform; declare, or use sum_k pi_k c_k = 0.
6 Degeneracy/rank policies are labels only: Refuse detects nothing (zero-variance y, one observed class); DeclaredSolverDiagnostic with reportedRank < r accepted (:90); PendingNumericalCheck admits a zero column. Add isIdentified or scaladoc stating rank-deficient factors are admissible.
7 DiagonalPlusLowRank carries no Psi values; u = A^T Psi^-1 x not computable. OK for this packet; record as caveat to the decoding consumer.
8 Continuous prior diagonal only (:46); full Sigma_y unrepresentable; block weights are full-length vectors, not a partition. Declare limitation.
9 AlderPatternArtifact.scala:40 fitted Pipe returns the artifact for any input incl. outer rows; document or make running it an error.

NIT
10 :129 InvalidRank reports max as targetAxis.size; should be K-1.
11 TrainingScopeMismatch conflates wrong expected receipt vs wrong binding digest.
12 TrainingBinding.declaredSampleAxis unchecked (documented :102-104).

VERIFIED CORRECT
- Orientation: A p x r, C q x r, shape checks :86-87 match x = A C^T y + eps. Stores forward A directly (Haufe transform not applicable).
- Hand oracle: Gale dense row-major, A=[[1,2],[0,1],[3,-1]], C=diag(2,3), y=(2,-1): C^T y=(4,-3), A(4,-3)=(-2,-3,15), matches suite :25-26 at 1e-12. Contrast rows (1,1/3),(-1,1/3),(0,-2/3) column-centered.
- Training binding: attach takes NonEmptyData[Use.Fit,...]; Alder Use has no public retag, so Evaluation/Test data cannot attach; digest checked vs expected receipt and data fingerprint; mismatch tests (Alder suite :30, :33) meaningful.
- Portability: shared code uses only Vector, math, Gale DMat.

ACCEPTANCE (bd-01M2BNG5AK37QZK08P4VK0966Z)
1 categorical+multivariate share model, no unlabeled targets: MET (:48-62, :128)
2 rank <= min(p,q), <= K-1, binary not presented as networks: PARTIAL (:84-85, :57, :126; component axis generic, no typed predictive-rank vs spatial-subdivision separation)
3 gauge/full-rank/centering-intercept/degeneracy explicit: PARTIAL (findings 1, 2, 6)
4 no dense p x q / p x p; experimental vs inference: MET (:80, :139)
PRD PAT-01 end-to-end (one fit serving classify/decode/encode vs dense Gaussian oracle) not addressed — outside this packet; keep open on consumers.

Required before close: 1-4 with variant-specific negatives. 5-12 fix or record as declared caveats.
